notes.title: 'What is Chuchel?' Explained!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30887835/80ea719399b0e648eee3a462be4e4b6f349b4b9a.png[/img]

It's time to answer one of the deepest questions of all time - [b]what the actual heck is Chuchel?![/b]

[h1][b]Czech & Weird[/b][/h1]
You guys already know we like to give our games some odd names and sometimes we even mix in a bit of Czech, our native language. For example 'Samorost' is a beautiful word for [i]an object or a person that was formed entirely by the effects of natural influences[/i]. Such as this wooden animal.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30887835/e6fc293c5884ed8c1bcc1beac4816f1f6c6a92e7.jpg[/img]

Chuchel is also a word coming from the Czech language. We use it to describe a [b]'ball of hair and dust'[/b]. You know, that soft kind of mess which appears in your house when you don't clean it properly. The less cleaning you do, the more chuchels you've got - that's how it works. This thing below is a prime example of chuchel found at Jakub Dvorsky's household. Magnificent, isn't it? 

By the way, Kekel, Chuchel's pet buddy/rival, also got his name from a Czech word for '[i]something terribly disgusting[/i]'. Seriously.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30887835/35444251040e72627aceb7c1213c29cbabc84a08.jpg[/img]

There's even a [url=https://www.google.cz/maps/place/Chuchel,+583+01+Je%C5%99i%C5%A1no/@49.8049598,15.6124891,14z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m5!3m4!1s0x470db2bf685713d9:0x6e5b0306dbc012a0!8m2!3d49.8049617!4d15.6299987]village[/url] called Chuchel. Rumors say it's got the highest consumption of cherries per capita in the entire world. Interesting. Reportedly it only has about 50 inhabitants, which seems appropriate for such a sacred place. Pilgrimage, anyone?

[h1][b]Quick maths![/b][/h1]
Anyway, our Chuchel is by no means disgusting. He's rather cute, cheerful, although a tad bit annoying and simple. His strong personality has two sources of inspiration - one of them is Jaromir Plachy, the creator of Chuchel himself, the other would be Jaromir's dog Anca. While Jaromir sees himself as a slightly bothersome person (only sometimes), Anca is an incredibly nice and naive being. Combine these two personalities and you'll get the most fabulous Chuchel out there.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11630467/92563dc05e9a53382e7350f0f8096c67e5c4fd03.png[/img]

[b]Get ready to experience Chuchel's hilarious tantrums on your own - the game arrives to Windows PC & Mac on March 7!![/b] 

Add it to your wishlist now and get notified as soon as it's available ːmrfeatherː

http://store.steampowered.com/app/711660/CHUCHEL/

notes.title: See how Samorost 3 was made in this new documentary movie
notes.content:
[b]We're happy to announce that [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/681040/New_Game_documentary_movie/]New Game: documentary movie[/url] is now available for purchase on Steam![/b]

The new film follows 4 very different teams working on 4 very different projects:
[list]
[*]Amanita Design with their newest adventure game Samorost 3
[*]Keen Software House with their space sandbox Space Engineers
[*]Dreadlocks with Ghost Theory, an upcoming first person horror game
[*]and a brand new team working on a game called Phonopolis
[/list]
The teams were captured in several emotional and dramatic situations - Dreadlocks failing their Kickstarter campaign, Amanita Design celebrating the launch of Samorost 3, the team behind Phonopolis running out of money and much more.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/681040/New_Game_documentary_movi
Enjoy watching!
